title: Upgraded Impinj R700 Reader Delivers Enterprise-Grade Edge Intelligence for Autonomous Reading Solutions
summary: New Impinj R700 RAIN RFID reader combines industry-leading performance with enhanced 64-bit processor, OS, and application memory
body_text: Upgraded Impinj R700 Reader Delivers Enterprise-Grade Edge Intelligence for Autonomous Reading Solutions New Impinj R700 RAIN RFID reader combines industry-leading performance with enhanced 64-bit processor, OS, and application memory Impinj high-performance fixed readers – led by our flagship Impinj R700 series – are the trusted engine for the most demanding RAIN RFID systems. Originally introduced in 2020 and now deployed across thousands of enterprise sites globally , R700 readers deliver best-in-class tag readability, enterprise-grade security, and modern IoT developer tools that enable our global ecosystem to build high-performance autonomous reading solutions. In 2024, we expanded R700’s capabilities with Gen2X, allowing for a new wave of autonomous applications that push the limits of RAIN RFID performance. Now, we are upgrading R700 to meet the increasing computational demands of these challenging use cases with the introduction of a more powerful and versatile R700 . With twice the processor performance and three times the embedded application memory size of its predecessor, the upgraded R700 maintains its best-in-class RFID performance while adding significant edge computing power, allowing enterprises to collect and manage data at the edge of networks, enabling real-time edge intelligence that helps optimize speed and automation. Designed with Autonomous Reading Solutions in Mind Innovative enterprises are increasingly shifting to next-generation supply chain solutions, enabled through autonomous RAIN RFID systems that automatically capture item data without human scanning or manual intervention. These solutions are unlocking the power of reliable, real-time data about every item that is manufactured, transported, and sold. Supply chains rely upon these solutions to automate high-speed package sortation and item-level shipment verification at dock doors, conveyors, and other transition points. Retail stores use these solutions to deliver always-on inventory visibility, automated checkout experiences, and high-precision loss prevention. Across industries, autonomous reading solutions empower enterprises to solve operational challenges, reduce labor costs, and increase supply chain integrity. “As early adopters of the new Impinj R700 RAIN RFID reader, we’re excited to see Impinj build on the R700’s best-in-class reading performance with increased computational power to meet the demands of today’s challenging autonomous applications,” said Matt Smith, Senior Director of Engineering, SLS . “These enhancements improve read-zone control and enable real-time item-level insights. Our SLS D-Series dock-door solution uses Impinj R700-series readers to deliver highly accurate reads and fast event alarming, helping our customers ensure accurate deliveries and shipments, lower shipping expenses, and improve ROI.” To deliver the reliability enterprises require from real-time autonomous solutions, RAIN RFID fixed reading systems must provide high accuracy and high-throughput reading performance in challenging use cases, where items are often in motion, densely packed, and/or inside tough and unpredictable RF environments. Traditional fixed reading systems rely on a single RFID tag read to make business-critical decisions, a model that often falls short for autonomous reading use cases, especially in challenging conditions. Today’s solutions often require multiple tag reads across multiple antennas and/or readers, as well as the fusion of sensor inputs with RFID tag reads. Enhanced edge processing capabilities enable on-reader applications that analyze these richer data streams at the network’s edge, transforming raw RAIN tag responses into precise, actionable, real-time insights that improve solution accuracy and latency while reducing network bandwidth use. Combining Best-in-Class Tag Readability and Edge Processing Performance The new Impinj R700 combines best-in-class R700 series RAIN RFID performance – further extended with Gen2X Performance capabilities – with industry-leading edge processing capabilities that are essential for deploying edge intelligence directly on the reader. It also extends the proven capabilities of the R700 series reader, enabling enterprises to: Ensure accurate and reliable RAIN system performance. The new R700 features industry-leading receive sensitivity and support for advanced features that enable reading connected items farther and faster, even in the most challenging and unpredictable RF environments. When R700 is paired with Impinj M700 and M800 series endpoint ICs, the Gen2X solutions toolbox further improves tag readability, especially for smaller tags, while also reducing stray or undesired tag reads that negatively impact system performance for tags-of-interest. Leverage critical edge intelligence. With 2x more powerful edge processing performance thanks to a dual-core 1 GHz 64-bit ARM A53 processor with a 64-bit Linux 6.6 operating system, as well as up to 3x more on-reader memory, the new R700 enables embedded applications and algorithms that transform RAIN data into actionable business intelligence at the edge while delivering enterprise-grade security and reliability. Simplify enterprise IoT solution development and deployments. Developer-friendly tools, multi-antenna support, rich connectivity, and seamless migration from existing R700 designs enable quick and efficient development of IoT solutions and faster time-to-market. Built on extensive learnings and a proven track record of enterprise-grade reliability from large-scale R700 deployments at Fortune 500 enterprises, the new R700 continues to meet strict information security and reliability requirements that keep enterprise data safe and operations up and running. A single R700 firmware version simplifies deployment and management across all R700 readers, reducing operational complexity and making it easier to scale. The updated R700 Embedded Toolkit enables developers to build a single application that runs across all R700 readers. As global demand for RAIN RFID continues to grow, we will continue to expand our Gen2X solution innovation toolbox . The new R700 is designed to support Gen2X Tag Sensitivity Improvements, a new Gen2X capability that delivers more power to tags to increase read range and readability. It also introduces Gen2X Tag Selection, which enables readers to better specify which tags should respond during inventory and which should remain quiet, helping enterprise solutions read only desired tags, along with additional Gen2X-only reader modes and future Gen2X innovations. An FPGA-based modem inside the new R700 gives readers the flexibility to add future Gen2X innovations via software upgrades. Get started with the new Impinj R700 Visit the Impinj R700 series product page to find detailed technical information about the new Impinj R700 and to connect with an Impinj representative. body_text: View all news AXT Announces Pricing of $550 Million Public Offering of Common Stock 04/21/2026 Download (opens in new window) FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- AXT, Inc. (NasdaqGS: AXTI) (“AXT” or the “Company”), a leading manufacturer of compound semiconductor wafer substrates, announced today the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 8,560,311 shares of common stock at a price to the public of $64.25 per share. The gross proceeds from the offering to the Company are expected to be approximately $550 million, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses. In addition, the Company granted the underwriter a 30-day option to purchase up to 1,284,046 additional shares of common stock at the public offering price, less the underwriting discounts (the “Overallotment Option”). If the Overallotment Option is fully exercised, the Company expects to receive aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $632.5 million, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses. The offering is expected to close on or about April 22, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the offering primarily to financially support our subsidiary Beijing Tongmei Xtal Technology Co., Ltd. in its efforts to increase its capacity to produce indium phosphide substrates for export worldwide, for research and development of new or improved products, and for working capital and for general corporate purposes. Northland Capital Markets is acting as sole bookrunner for this offering. Needham & Company, B. Riley Securities, Craig-Hallum Capital Group LLC and Wedbush Securities Inc. are acting as co-managers for this offering. An effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3ASR relating to the securities offered in the public offering described above was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) on April 20, 2026 (File No. 333-295188). About AXT, Inc. AXT is a material science company that develops and manufactures high-performance compound and single element semiconductor substrate wafers comprising indium phosphide (InP), gallium arsenide (GaAs) and germanium (Ge). The company’s substrate wafers are used when a typical silicon substrate wafer cannot meet the performance requirements of a semiconductor or optoelectronic device. End markets include 5G infrastructure, data center connectivity (silicon photonics), passive optical networks, LED lighting, lasers, sensors, power amplifiers for wireless devices and satellite solar cells. AXT’s worldwide headquarters are in Fremont, California where the company maintains sales, administration and customer service functions. AXT has its Asia headquarters in Beijing, China and manufacturing facilities in three separate locations in China. In addition, as part of its supply chain strategy, the company has partial ownership in ten companies in China producing raw materials for its manufacturing process. If the Company’s tendered shares are accepted and the exchange occurs in the second quarter of 2026, Commerce expects to record a significant gain during the second quarter of 2026, based on the conversion privilege of the Class C common stock and the closing price of Visa Class A common stock. Additionally, if the tendered shares are accepted and the exchange occurs in the second quarter of 2026, Commerce may execute other strategic initiatives, including evaluating its investment portfolio as part of its ongoing capital and balance‑sheet management strategy. This may include repositioning a portion of the Company’s investment securities portfolio through the sale of available-for-sale debt securities, which may result in a significant loss, and the purchase of investment securities at current market yields to enhance net interest income, manage interest rate risk, and improve the overall quality and flexibility of the company’s balance sheet.
